brief:
Israeli soldiers delayed a Palestinian ambulance transporting a pregnant woman in critical condition on July 27, 2026, forcing the medical crew to turn off their equipment for at least 20 minutes, Human Rights Watch reported. The woman underwent an emergency delivery, but her fetus did not survive. Israeli road closures in the West Bank were responsible for the initial delay.

The incident is part of a broader pattern. From January through June, the rights group documented additional cases in which Israeli checkpoints and road restrictions hampered Palestinian ambulance movements across the West Bank.
